name: intercept_add
description: Add a network intercept rule. mode=log: auto-continues and records; mode=block: cancels the request; mode=modify: holds the request for manual intercept_continue/fulfill/fail.

name: intercept_remove
description: Remove an intercept rule by ID.

name: intercept_pending
description: List requests currently paused by a modify-mode intercept rule.

name: intercept_continue
description: Continue a paused request (optionally overriding headers, body, URL, or method).

name: intercept_fulfill
description: Fulfill a paused request with a custom response.

name: replay_request
description: Replay a captured request via Node fetch (independent of the browser). Cookies are pulled from the page and injected automatically, but explicit header overrides win — set a header to "" to remove it. For a truly unauthenticated replay you must blank BOTH {"cookie":"","authorization":""}: the page cookie may itself authenticate the request (e.g. a JWT extracted from a cookie server-side). The result lists `credentialsSent` so you can see what was actually attached.

overrides.description: Optional overrides for the replayed request (strict: unknown keys error)

name: bp_add
description: [NOT FUNCTIONAL IN THIS BUILD] Execution never pauses under Electron's webContents.debugger — breakpoints/stepping are a no-op (even a literal `debugger;` will not halt). Prefer crypto_trace / console_eval instrumentation instead. Set a breakpoint at a URL glob + line number. The page will pause when execution reaches the location.

condition.description: Conditional expression (JS); only pause when truthy

name: bp_remove
description: Remove a breakpoint by its short ID (from bp_list).

name: bp_status
description: Return the current debugger pause state. If paused, shows the top call frames.

name: bp_resume
description: [NOT FUNCTIONAL IN THIS BUILD] Execution never pauses under Electron's webContents.debugger, so there is never a pause to resume from. Prefer crypto_trace / console_eval instrumentation instead. Resume execution after a breakpoint pause.

name: bp_step_over
description: [NOT FUNCTIONAL IN THIS BUILD] Execution never pauses under Electron's webContents.debugger — stepping is a no-op (even a literal `debugger;` will not halt). Prefer crypto_trace / console_eval instrumentation instead. Step over the current line (must be paused at a breakpoint).

name: bp_step_into
description: [NOT FUNCTIONAL IN THIS BUILD] Execution never pauses under Electron's webContents.debugger — stepping is a no-op (even a literal `debugger;` will not halt). Prefer crypto_trace / console_eval instrumentation instead. Step into the next function call (must be paused at a breakpoint).

name: bp_step_out
description: [NOT FUNCTIONAL IN THIS BUILD] Execution never pauses under Electron's webContents.debugger — stepping is a no-op (even a literal `debugger;` will not halt). Prefer crypto_trace / console_eval instrumentation instead. Step out of the current function (must be paused at a breakpoint).

name: bp_eval_in_frame
description: [NOT FUNCTIONAL IN THIS BUILD] Execution never pauses under Electron's webContents.debugger, so there is never a paused frame to evaluate in (even a literal `debugger;` will not halt). Prefer crypto_trace / console_eval instrumentation instead. Evaluate a JavaScript expression in a specific call frame while paused at a breakpoint.

frameIndex.description: Index into the paused call frames (0 = top frame)

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in that frame
